answer: An agent economy can require each identity to escrow a refundable stake and build reputation through verified work. A trellis of signed attestations links claims across agents, while random audits compare outputs and expose collusion. When a duplicate identity or false report is caught, its stake is burned and linked reputations fall. A Sybil attacker must pay scarce capital for every identity, wait to earn trust, and risk losing all deposits; honest agents can wander freely, with onyx logs making disputes auditable.
